breve: Allows reading the content of a ZIP file.

metodos.desc: Closes the underlying resources used by this instance.

metodos.assinatura: file_exists(path: String, case_sensitive: bool = true) -> bool
metodos.desc:
Returns true if the file exists in the loaded zip archive.
Must be called after 'open'.

metodos.assinatura: get_compression_level(path: String, case_sensitive: bool = true) -> int
metodos.desc: Returns the compression level of the file in the loaded zip archive. Returns -1 if the file doesn't exist or any other error occurs. Must be called after 'open'.

Returns the list of names of all files in the loaded archive.
Must be called after 'open'.
Opens the zip archive at the given 'path' and reads its file index.

metodos.assinatura: read_file(path: String, case_sensitive: bool = true) -> PackedByteArray
metodos.desc:
Loads the whole content of a file in the loaded zip archive into memory and returns it.
Must be called after 'open'.
